contentPattern: One row per slide, three cells: (1) media - background picture and/or a link to a video file (mp4/webm) which becomes a muted looping background video with the picture as poster; (2) content - rich text, typically a heading and a link (e.g. 'Saiba Mais'), rendered as a callout panel; (3) tab label - short plain text shown in the pill tab bar (falls back to the slide heading, then the slide number). Slides cross-fade and auto-rotate with a pause/play toggle; a single row renders as a static hero.
reuseGuidance: Use for top-of-page product heroes with 2-5 switchable slides. For a single static hero use the hero block. Keep tab labels to one or two words. 'grey-light' renders only the dot/pause control strip and suits a minimal slider where tabs are not wanted.
usageDescription: Full-width auto-rotating hero at the top of product pages: background photo or video per slide, a pill tab bar to switch slides, a callout panel with heading and link, and a pause control. 'light' uses a light callout panel; 'video' slides use a background video; 'grey-light' is a compact dots + pause control strip.
